segments.name: Furniture
segments.description: Designer and distributor of contemporary residential and commercial furniture sold through wholesale, retail and online channels worldwide.
segments.evidence: XMax Inc. (the "Company"), formerly known as Nova LifeStyle, Inc. and Stevens Resources, Inc, is a U.S.-headquartered innovative designer and distributor of contemporary styled residential and commercial furniture incorporated into a dynamic marketing and sales platform offering retail as well as online selection and global purchase fulfillment.

revenueModel.text: Customers including designers, distributors and retailers pay for furniture products through wholesale, retail and online sales channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers principally consist of designers, distributors and retailers who cater to mid-level and high-end private label home furnishings that have little product overlap within our specific furnishings products or product lines.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company sold entire jade mats inventory in liquidation sales and exited the Jade Mats business which had been acquired in 2019.
changes.evidence: Due to the negative impact caused by COVID-19, we eventually sold the entire jade mats inventory in liquidation sales in June 2023 and existed from Jade Mats business.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company completed de-registration and liquidation of Nova HK and transferred its operations to Nova Malaysia in 2022.
changes.evidence: In February 2023, Nova HK was completed the process of de-registration and liquidation.
